meta.note: Figures older than the staleness cutoff and not HISTORICAL or CURRENT are flagged STALE. The cutoff is derived as six months before meta.generated (see stalenessCutoff() in assets/ledger-core.js), so it moves with every rebuild instead of drifting. Set meta.staleness_cutoff explicitly only to override. Fuzzy vintages approximated: FYxx -> Mar 31 of that FY; 'Qn yyyy' -> quarter-end; bare year -> Dec 31; 'current'/statute -> CURRENT (never stale).

flag_legend.WEAK_TIER: Sole source is T4/T5 (or T3/T4 with no primary) - cannot stand alone for a volume/adoption/performance figure
flag_legend.STALE: Older than staleness_cutoff, non-historical, non-evergreen - re-pull before external use
flag_legend.HISTORICAL: Old but stable fact - do not amber-flag
flag_legend.CONFLICT: Another module gave a different number for the same quantity - see reconciliation
flag_legend.UNVERIFIED: T5-only, flagged in-text - source or remove before external use
flag_legend.DERIVED: Conversion or price-inflated valuation, not a mobilisable/measured base
flag_legend.VAGUE: Figure stated imprecisely by the source

tier_legend.T2: Named data provider - RWA.xyz, DefiLlama, World Bank, etc.
